title: Resolution to declare April 7 White Star Family Day
summary: This resolution would declare April 7 as White Star Family Day in New York City to recognize families who have lost a servicemember or veteran to suicide. It notes that in 2023, 167 New York State veterans died by suicide, the highest number in over 20 years and a 25.8 percent increase from 2022. It states that unlike Gold Star Families, these families receive no formal federal recognition or dedicated survivor benefits.
